Hi all — joined the sync notes here with concrete next steps from EvalOps: 

Summary of what I pulled from BrightCart's prompt CSV: 12 prompt families, ~240 seed prompts across categories (search-assist, upsell, returns). File looks good; only minor normalization required (context tokens inconsistent).

Planned Eval Integration:
- Aug 24-25: Normalize prompt formats and map to evaluation suites (corr. to user flows).
- Aug 26-27: Run baseline evals against current prod model and the proposed model variant (quantized v2).
- Aug 27: Push baseline results to shared Drive and mark baseline tags in the eval harness.

Regression alerts proposal (initial):
- Precision drop: absolute drop >= 6% over baseline (1h rolling window) => severity: P2
- Hallucination rate: increase >= 4% over baseline (24h window) => severity: P2
- Latency: p95 increase > 150ms vs baseline (30m window) => severity: P3
- Quality drift: test-set score decrease >= 3% with confirmed statistical significance => automatic canary halt

Canary/rollback policy (draft):
- Start at 5% traffic for 6 hours. If any P2 triggers occur twice in two independent 1h windows OR quality drift is detected, automatically scale canary down to 0% and notify on-call.
- Manual rollback authority: Rishi + BrightCart eng lead.

Deliverables I will attach by Aug 27: evaluation report (CSV), alert rule set (yaml), and suggested playbook (canary_playbook.md).

Questions for BrightCart: who is the engineering lead for canary authorizations (name + email)? Also confirm the Slack channel you want alerts posted to.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Principal, EvalOps — Redwood Inference
